integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically from the exact interval structure of complete multipartite graphs and independently stress-tested by exhaustive literal shortest-path closure through order nine. Finite computation is supporting evidence, not the infinite proof.
limitations: Specific to ordinary shortest-path (geodetic) convexity on connected complete multipartite graphs. Generic cograph and distance-hereditary algorithms already cover minimum-hull computation; novelty is claimed only for the explicit all-set classification and closed cardinality enumerator. An obscure earlier family-specific formula under alternate terminology remains a bibliographic residual risk.
title: All geodetic hull sets of complete multipartite graphs
